issue.title: [IssueOps] Copilot AI budget: payments-api to $2,500/month
issue.body:
### Budget scope

repository

### Scope target

payments-api

### Metered product

AI credits

### Requested monthly budget (USD)

2500

### Enforcement

Stop usage when the budget is reached

### Alert recipients

dana-dev, gia-pay

### Budget expiry date

_No response_

### Chargeback cost center

CC-4410-PAYMENTS

### Business justification

The payments team moved PCI evidence collection and ledger reconciliation refactors to Copilot agent mode and the cloud agent in August. The repository hit its $800 budget on the 19th and usage was blocked for two days. Q3 forecast from the ROI report: ~$2,100/month.

### Acknowledgements

- [X] I understand spend up to this amount is billed to CoolEngEnt and charged back to the cost center above
- [X] My manager is aware of this request
